name: This Is Love
storyline:
Have you ever been in a toxic relationship with a partner, friends, or family without even realizing it? Maybe this adventure will open your eyes.

This is Love is a 2D puzzle-platformer that delves into the dark emotions behind toxic bonds. You’ll guide an endearing character through 100 heart-wrenching real-life quotes collected from people who lived these painful experiences, all while evading a sinister antagonist determined to keep you under control.

In This is Love, each of the 50 levels is an emotional journey, accompanied by real-life quotes that reflect the psychological and emotional struggles of abusive relationships. You'll explore symbolic, minimalist, and visually striking environments as your antagonist confronts you with manipulative, unsettling messages—constantly trying to reopen old wounds.

Your goal isn't just to move forward, but to understand, heal, and rediscover your inner strength.
summary: Guide a small character through platforming and puzzle levels that explore the emotions of a toxic relationship. Uncover harrowing real quotes shared by those who endured it as you flee an antagonist determined to keep you captive while searching for freedom.
